introduction: FCCU was founded in 1864 with a vision to impart quality education to the people of this region and to contribute to their academic, economic and social development. From the premises of a small college, FCCU has grown into an academically robust university that offers a wide range of opportunities to its students to grow and reach their full potential. FCCU welcomes students from all backgrounds and all regions of Pakistan and abroad to a University where they live, grow and learn, meet some of the greatest thinkers in their chosen disciplines and make lifelong friendships- a place they can truly call home.

computer_science.program_description: The BS Computer Science degree program at FCCU is duly accredited by NCEAC (National Computing Education Accreditation Council) of HEC and is complemented by the University's liberal arts education system. The program provides a solid understanding of the theory and techniques of Computer Science so that upon graduation the students can enter various industries or pursue graduate studies. Our courses are a mix from various areas that reflect the excitement and joy of computing, e.g. mathematics, electronics, algorithms, programming, theoretical computer science, artificial intelligence, application development, software engineering, networks, operating systems, databases, computer vision, human-computer interaction and more.

admission_criteria.criteria: Students who have passed their Intermediate with at least 60% marks
A-Level students who have cleared at least 3 principal A-Level exams (not AS Level) with minimum B grades
A-Level students who have given their A levels exams in October, November and are awaiting results
Students who have done their American High School with minimum 70% marks. Equivalence needed attested from IBCC
Students who have done their Intermediate from the Technical Board with minimum 60% marks
Mathematics is mandatory for Computer Science program

software_engineering.program_description: The BS Software Engineering program at FCCU is designed to produce skilled software engineers who can design, develop, and maintain complex software systems. The program combines theoretical foundations with practical experience, preparing students for careers in software development, project management, and technology leadership.

A-Level students who have cleared at least 3 principal A-Level exams with minimum B grades
Mathematics is mandatory for Software Engineering program
